text: Kala golluɗo ko moƴƴi, ko kanko nafitorta ɗum, wanaa Allah nafitorta golle moƴƴe hay gooto. Kala kadi huuwuɗo ko boni, lorra mun ko e makko yantata, wanaa Allah woni ko bone geddi gooto e tagu Makko ngun, lorrata. O yoɓoyay kala e ko hanndi kon. Joomi maa an Nulaaɗo, O siforaali wonnde, tooñoowo jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen. O ɗuytanoytaaɓe moƴƴi maɓɓe, O ɓeydanoytaaɓe kadi bonɗi.
